infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.urlText: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. Some trains do not stop at Wolli Creek. Sydney Metro and City Circle trackwork may also affect how you travel
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 9 and Sunday 10 May  
  • Daily from 6.30am to 12.15pm, some trains make extra stops between Sutherland and Hurstville.

  • Sunday from 1pm to 4pm, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make extra stops at Arncliffe and Sydenham.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek, or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.
Sydney Metro and City Circle train trackwork may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run between Central and Wynyard, or on the City Circle.
  • For travel in the City use trains, light rail or local buses.
  • Sydney Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Tallawong.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return (Sunday 1pm to 4pm only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland. Some trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 9 and Sunday 10 May
  • Buses replace trains between Cronulla and Sutherland.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Waterfall, Sutherland and Bondi Junction.

  • Daily from 6.30am to 12.15pm, some trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern.
  • Some trains start or end at Hurstville or Sutherland. You may need to change trains to continue your journey.
  • Trains may leave from different platforms, please check indicator screens before boarding.

  • Sunday from 1pm to 4pm, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.
Sydney Metro and City Circle train trackwork may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run between Central and Wynyard, or on the City Circle.
  • For travel in the City use trains, light rail or local buses.
  • Sydney Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Tallawong.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
33T4 Cronulla, all stations to Sutherland and return
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return (Sunday 1pm to 4pm only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: Station Update - Bardwell Park
infoLinks.content:
Access to Bardwell Park Station is via temporary stairs on the eastern side of Hartill-Law Avenue to enable the demolition of the existing station stairs and construction of new stairs and a lift on the western side of Hartill-Law Avenue. Allow extra time to safely cross the road at the signalised pedestrian crossing at the corner of Hartill-Law Avenue and Slade Road.

Please also note that there are no public toilets available at this station until further notice.

infoLinks.urlText: Route 301 bus to return from Monday 20 April
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 April 2026 the partially reinstated bus Route 301 will begin operating.  
Bus Route 301 previously operated from Redfern Station to Eastgardens via Rosebery, Eastlakes and Mascot and was replaced by other routes as part of wider network changes introduced in 2021. 
These changes will provide improved connections between Rosebery, Eastlakes and Westfield Eastgardens, via Mascot shops.  
This service will operate Monday to Saturdays operating approximately every half an hour, with the first service arriving at Eastgardens just before 10am and the last service leaving Eastgardens just after 5pm.  On weekday afternoons services will operate approximately every 60 minutes. 
There will be no changes to existing bus routes in the area, such as bus route 303, 306 and 305.  
We encourage passengers to plan their trip in advance using Transport’s Trip Planner.

infoLinks.urlText: School bus service changes - Coffs Harbour area
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 20 April 2026, some school bus services in the Coffs Harbour area will change. 
  • S244 will have a changed timetable and path.
  • S300 will have a changed timetable.
  • S291 will have a changed timetable.
  • S244 will no longer operate through Orlando Street, Brodie Drive, Glynn Street, or Harbour Drive between Orlando St and Hogbin Drive.
Students currently boarding S244 on Orlando St, Brodie Dr, Glynn St & Harbour Dr will be required to instead board S300 and transfer to S244 at Coffs Harbour Public School Interchange.
  • New transfer opportunity from S291 to S244 at York St after Arthur St will also be available for students residing in Diggers Beach.
Plan your trip for real-time up to date information. 
  
Routes affected: 
  • S244 - Coffs Harbour Pacific Hwy to Coffs Harbour City Centre via Orlando St
  • S300 - Coffs Harbour to Coffs Harbour Education Campus
  • S291 - Coffs Harbour to St John Paul via Coffs Harbour Jetty

infoLinks.urlText: Brooklyn Ferry Wharf closure
infoLinks.content:
Hornsby Shire Council will be upgrading the Brooklyn Ferry Wharf starting Tuesday 28 April. There will be no access to the Wharf for the Brooklyn Ferry Services and services will be suspended from Tuesday 28 April for up to 6 weeks.
 
Council is providing a Water Taxi service and is expected to operate on the same existing Ferry timetable, however customers are advised to contact Hornsby Shire Council on 02 9847 6071 for any queries regarding the project and to contact the local water taxi provider on 0427 890 177 to confirm the Water Taxi arrangements.
 
TfNSW apologies for any inconvenience caused to our customers during the upgrade of the Brooklyn Ferry Wharf and will confirm the reopening date upon confirmation from Council.

infoLinks.urlText: T1 Western Line: Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern. You may need to change trains to continue your journey
infoLinks.content:
Saturday 9 and Sunday 10 May    
  • Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern between:
    • Richmond and Liverpool. Change at Parramatta for trains towards Central
    • Penrith and Central, platforms 1-14 only, making extra stops at Homebush, Flemington and Burwood.

  • Saturday from 8.45pm to 2.30am, buses replace trains between Olympic Park and Central.
  • Penrith trains run to a changed timetable between Penrith and Olympic Park.
  • Rail replacement buses do not leave from Lidcombe.
Sydney Metro and City Circle train trackwork may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run between Central and Wynyard, or on the City Circle.
  • For travel in the City use T4 trains, light rail or local buses.
  • Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Tallawong.
  • T1 North Shore Line trains start from Wynyard.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
44T2 Strathfield, all stations to Stanmore, Central and return
47T2 Strathfield, all stations to Central and return

Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

urlText: Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern
content:
Saturday 9 and Sunday 10 May    
  • Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Express trains continue to run.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington and Lidcombe only. Change at Lidcombe for trains towards Central or T1 Western Line stations.

  • Saturday from 8.45pm to 2.30am, buses replace all trains between Olympic Park and Central.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between Leppington and Lidcombe or Olympic Park, via Granville or Regents Park.
  • Rail replacement buses do not leave from Lidcombe.
Sydney Metro and City Circle train trackwork may also affect how you travel
  • Trains do not run between Central and Wynyard, or on the City Circle.
  • For travel in the City use T4 trains, light rail or local buses.
  • Sydney Metro services do not run between Sydenham and Tallawong.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
44T2 Strathfield, all stations to Stanmore, express to Central and return
47T2 Strathfield, all stations to Central and return
 
42T7 Olympic Park, Strathfield, express to Central and return (Saturday night only)
43T7 Olympic Park, Flemington, Homebush, Strathfield, express to Central, and return (Saturday night only)
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
subtitle: Buses replace Inner West trains between Strathfield and Central. Trains run to a changed timetable and stopping pattern

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services in Lithgow
infoLinks.content:
There are timetable changes to school transport services impacted by the closure of the Great Western Highway at Victoria Pass. Changes should reduce travel time for the majority of students.  
  • Some students may have different times for their bus service or a slightly longer walk to their bus stop. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by bus from Hartley Vale to Lithgow train station and transfer to a train to Wentworth Falls. 
  • Some students attending Blue Mountains Grammar will travel in the mornings by train from Blackheath station to Wentworth Falls station.  
  • Journey times are subject to traffic volumes. 
  • Check the Trip Planner for the latest.

infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Glenfield and Sydenham
infoLinks.content:
Monday 27 and Tuesday 28 April 
  • Nightly from 9.30pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Glenfield and Sydenham.
  • Trains run to a changed timetable between:
    • Macarthur and the City via Granville
    • Sydenham and the City
    • Turrella and the City via the Airport.
  • Monday from 9.50pm, trains run between Turrella and Central only, due to City Circle trackwork.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
19T8 Glenfield, all stations to Padstow, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
23T8 East Hills, all stations to Turrella, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

infoLinks.urlText: L2 and L3 light rail services may be temporarily held at stops or partially closed due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
On Sunday, L2 Randwick Line and L3 Kingsford Line light rail services may be impacted between 11.30am and 12.30pm approximately due to road closures around Town Hall for a planned Police Operation protest march:  
  • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily held at stops, or  
  • L2 and L3 services may be temporarily partially closed between Circular Quay and Town Hall.  
Impact to services and timings may change at the direction of NSW Police.  
Please check information screens at stops, listen to announcements and follow the direction of staff or Police on site, as necessary.  
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner for alternative transport options, including trains, buses or walking.  
L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services should continue to run as per normal.

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney CBD diversions due to Police Operation
infoLinks.content:
From 1.20pm until 4pm on Sunday 26 April, buses will divert and miss stops due to road closures in place for a planned Police Operation protest march. 
Buses to the city will divert via Wentworth Ave and Liverpool St and end trips at Museum Station. Buses will not continue to Circular Quay. 
Buses leaving the city will start trips from Museum Station, Elizabeth St, Stand A. 
Catch trains or light rail services to continue your trip between Museum and Circular Quay.

infoLinks.urlText: Changes to school bus services impacted by Waterfall Way closure
infoLinks.content:
Some school buses are not running due to the closure of Waterfall Way west of Bellingen due to a landslip.  
As an interim solution for school students in the Dorrigo and Bellingen area, a fleet of minibuses will operate school services via the detour on Summervilles Road.
From Monday 9 February, a phased approach has commenced for school bus services. Families should stay abreast of communication being distributed via their schools.
Sign up for SMS updates about interim bus service cancellations
Inclement weather and road conditions have the potential to prevent interim bus movements on the detour route and cancel services.
Transport has set up an SMS service to notify families of cancellations of services. Opt in to receive SMS via this link.
Routes affected:
  • S110
  • S125
  • S126
  • S127
  • S887

infoLinks.urlText: Sydney Olympic Park bus diversions for State of Origin Game I
infoLinks.content:
• From 7am to 8.30am, then from 3pm to 4.15pm, on Tuesday 26 and Wednesday 27 May, school routes 665s, 760s and 761s services will divert while roads are closed in Sydney Olympic Park for State of Origin Game I. 
  • Services in both directions will divert via Edwin Flack Avenue, Sarah Durack Avenue and Australia Avenue, and will miss stops on Dawn Fraser Avenue and Park Street. Catch these services from the stop on Park Street at Olympic Park train station or other alternative stop locations on Edwin Flack Avenue.  
  • Allow extra time and check signs at stops for alternate stop locations. Visit the State of Origin Game I event page for more details.  
Closed and alternative stops 
  • Park Street opposite Olympic Park Station (212790) 
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street (212712) 
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue opposite Olympic Park Station (212791) 
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street (212712) 
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue before Edwin Flack Avenue (212788) 
    Alternative stop: Edwin Flack Avenue opposite Accor Stadium (212735) 
  • Dawn Fraser Avenue after Edwin Flack Avenue (212787) 
    Alternative stop: Accor Stadium, Edwin Flack Avenue (212736) 
  • Olympic Park Station, Dawn Fraser Avenue (212792) 
    Alternative stop: Olympic Park Station, Park Street (212712)
